page: Amazon Web Services r9g.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by AWS Graviton processors. Built on the arm64 architecture, it features 4 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance utilizes the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which ensures dedicated resource allocation with a single thread per core.

This server configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options. Baseline network performance is rated at 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of dedicated arm64 cores and a high memory allocation makes this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads. It is designed for applications such as in-memory databases, caching layers, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications that benefit from a high RAM-to-vCPU ratio without requiring local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
